variant: AK-74M 5.45x39, 415 mm barrel, black polymer furniture (upper + lower handguard, pistol grip), side-folding solid polymer stock (folds to the LEFT), 30-rd black polymer magazine, two-port muzzle brake, left-side optic mount rail, stamped receiver with ribbed dust cover. Profile masters: refs_user 163245 (left side, muzzle left) and 163254 (right side, muzzle right).
variant_lock_notes: All 12 user references show the same rifle (black AK-74M). akt4anatomy.jpg is a chart (plum furniture) used for part names only; colours/furniture from the photos win. The two images pasted in chat (field strip on a mat, railed 'tactical' AK) were never attached as files and are not used.
units: Blender metres (1 BU = 1 m = 100 UE cm); specs in mm

frame.axes: +Y muzzle, +X the gun's LEFT, +Z up (gun frame G)
frame.origin: top-rear of the pistol grip where it meets the receiver (grip top centre)
frame.B_frame: authoring frame B: origin on the bore axis at the muzzle-brake face, +Y toward the muzzle (so the gun lies at Y < 0), +Z up, +X gun left; G = B - ORIGIN_B (ak_spec.py)

assemblies.Receiver: stamped receiver + trunnions, rivets, rear sight block + leaf, side rail, trigger guard, pistol-grip bolt
assemblies.DustCover: moving part: lifts off; pivot = rear-sight-block notch front
assemblies.BoltCarrier: moving part: carrier + piston + charging handle, travels -Y
assemblies.Barrel: barrel + front sight block + gas block + cleaning rod + handguard retainer
assemblies.Stock: side-folding polymer stock + hinge, pivot = hinge axis (folds to +X / gun left)
assemblies.Controls: selector lever (pivot at its axle), magazine catch, trigger

textures: BaseColor (sRGB) / Normal (OpenGL; flip green in UE) / ORM / Mask (universal lab master: R steel finish A, G polymer B, B print area, A wear)
no_marks: no factory proof marks, arsenal logos, serials or text: blank recesses only
